name: OpenReview
tagline: Vercel Labs' self-hosted GitHub review bot: mention @openreview for Claude-powered inline suggestions; dormant beta since March 2026.
license: None (no LICENSE file as of Aug 2026; README says MIT)
pricing: Free to run; you pay your own Anthropic API and Vercel hosting. Beta with no commits since March 2026 (~1.5K stars, not archived)
selfHostedNote: Self-hosted only: deploy the Next.js app to Vercel with your own GitHub App credentials and Anthropic key.
modelControl: BYOK Anthropic key on your own deployment; model hardcoded (Claude Sonnet 4.6), no provider choice without forking

01-multi-dimensional-context.note: Explores the codebase and runs project tooling during review; single repo, no persistent index.

02-rule-centric.note: Reviews only when mentioned, quiet by design; extensible skills in .agents/skills, no severity config.

03-dual-workflow.note: GitHub App reviewing PRs only; no IDE, CLI, or pre-commit surface.

04-business-logic.note: No issue tracker or MCP integration documented; reviews the PR in isolation.

05-continuous-learning.note: Emoji reactions gate applying fixes per PR; no persistent learning from feedback.

06-sandbox-validation.note: Runs project tooling (lint/format) as part of review; no documented test execution or preview environments.

07-economic-transparency.note: Runs on your infra with your Anthropic key at zero markup; model hardcoded, no model independence.

08-actionability.note: Inline GitHub suggestion blocks with one-click apply; commits simple fixes directly to the PR branch.

09-measurable-roi.note: No dashboards or metrics of any kind.
